data.gender_notes: Cagatay is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Turkish word 'Cagatay', meaning 'victorious horse' or 'leader of victory'. The name Cagatay carries the meaning “Victorious horse” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Turkic. Parents who choose Cagatay usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious horse and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Cagatay is a name that resonates with the spirit of the brave warrior, inspiring strength and courage in those who bear it. It is a name that carries the energy of the horse, a symbol of power, freedom, and independence.
data.etymology: Cagatay belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious horse.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Cagatay total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
